units.source_text: 铁锹一握在手，骨架像折叠式三脚架似的，因疲劳而一点点缩短了。

en.t: Once he had the shovel in his hands, his frame, like a folding tripod, gradually shrank under the weight of exhaustion.

units.source_text: 而且，昨天晚上开始几乎就没合过眼。

en.t: Besides, he had scarcely closed his eyes since the night before.

units.source_text: 首先，似乎有必要预先和女人商量一下，最少得干多少活。

en.t: First of all, it seemed necessary to talk it over with the woman beforehand and decide the minimum amount of work he had to do.
But he could not be bothered to open his mouth.

units.source_text: 大概刚才跟老头说话时力气用得太过头了，

en.t: Perhaps he had used up too much strength when he was talking to the old man a little earlier,

units.source_text: 声带简直像松软鱿鱼片的纤维似的，变得破破烂烂。

en.t: for his vocal cords felt like the fibers of soft sliced squid, frayed and ragged.

units.source_text: 他和女人并排，机械地挥着铁锹。

en.t: Side by side with the woman, he swung the shovel mechanically.
